architecture.name: LaneDG-Semantic-Reimplementation-v1
architecture.status: documented semantic adaptation; not verified equivalent to cited YOLOv8n-LaneDG
architecture.backbone: Conv stem; DGF at P2/P3/P5; C2f; SPPF
architecture.neck: C2f FPN-PAN with both top-down and bottom-up paths
architecture.head: EUCB multi-scale semantic decoder; one full-resolution binary logit map
differences_from_cited_model: semantic union mask replaces instance/prototype/detection outputs
no CIoU box or object-classification loss, detection confidences, or NMS
channel widths, C2f repeats, gates, shuffle groups, and decoder are explicit reconstruction choices
no claim to reproduce the cited paper's parameter count or published scores

preprocessing.task: binary semantic lane segmentation; not official instance/lane metrics
preprocessing.resize: direct stretch to square; OpenCV INTER_LINEAR RGB image; no cropping or letterbox
preprocessing.rasterization: OpenCV LINE_8 polylines after coordinate transform; width 3 output pixels; no polygon filling
preprocessing.tusimple: connect consecutive valid x>=0 samples; split at missing samples; do not extrapolate
preprocessing.culane: all annotated lane polylines; corrected annotations_new for train/val; retain annotated occluded portions
preprocessing.bdd100k_ignore: crosswalks, curbs, vertical lanes, explicit ignore=true and occluded=true lane objects: rasterized support excluded from loss and metrics
preprocessing.bdd100k_curves: cubic Bezier segments sampled at 64 intervals; match official Matplotlib Path semantics: first point MOVETO; a C consumes the next three vertices irrespective of their subsequent codes (supports legacy CCCL)
preprocessing.bdd100k_dashed: annotated continuous geometry retained, without inventing dash gaps
preprocessing.occlusion: no synthesized occluded geometry; retain provided TuSimple/CULane geometry; explicitly occluded BDD lanes ignored
preprocessing.background: all pixels not marked positive or ignored; unlabeled lanes are background under this harmonized protocol
preprocessing.empty_masks: retain negative images; image IoU=1 for empty prediction and empty truth; otherwise union IoU

selection: minimum source-validation loss checkpoint; threshold chosen from source-validation data only
evaluation: all three source models frozen; same three held-out target subsets; all training complete before any target metrics
loss: masked BCE + per-image Dice + 0.5 bidirectional valid-lane continuity
augmentation: epoch-varying horizontal flip p=0.5 and brightness +/-0.08, contrast 0.85..1.15; training only
uncertainty: 2000 sequence-cluster bootstrap resamples per checkpoint; training seeds reported separately
